versions.localizedDescription:
v1.11.1•280
Beta 2

Read along
• New • Read along in the ebook reader: the narration is highlighted on the page as the audiobook plays, word by word or a sentence at a time, and the pages turn themselves. Needs the audiobook downloaded and on•device transcription turned on
• New • A Read along button on the card for books with an epub. It opens the reader at your spot, waits paused while the transcript gets ahead of the narration, then carries on by itself
• New • Live transcript on the card for podcasts and books without an epub, with the words rolling in as they are spoken
• New • Word or sentence tracking and the highlight color live in the reader's text settings
• New • A button in transcription settings to clear the transcript cache

Ebook reader
• New • A setting to keep the title and progress bar on screen above the page instead of showing them on tap
• Fix • Find in audiobook finds a passage at the start of a chapter in books where every chapter is its own file

Syncing
• Fix • Coming back online no longer drags a paused book back to the position the server had before you lost the connection
• Fix • Leaving WiFi mid•book keeps syncing through the remote address instead of trying the home network for the rest of the session

v1.11.1•279
Beta 1

Syncing
• Fix • The progress percent no longer gets stuck on the server for downloaded books and paused podcast episodes while the position kept moving (376)
• Fix • A downloaded book keeps syncing after a rough patch of network instead of giving up until the app is opened

Series queue
• Fix • The series queue works past book 100 (377)
• Improved • Manage Queue opens at the book you are on, fits three•digit numbers, and no longer refetches the series every time you open it

Finished status
• Fix • Resetting a podcast episode clears it on the server and stays cleared instead of coming back
• Improved • Mark as not finished puts the book back at the start everywhere, like the web app does, instead of silently keeping the old spot in the app

Watch
• Fix • Downloaded books show their cover on Pixel Watch media controls again

Ebook reader
• Improved • Auto scroll on two•column spreads scrolls one column at a time
• Fix • Find in audiobook keeps looking when the chapter markers don't line up with the ebook
• Fix • The reader's play button no longer vanishes on the dark and grey looks in e•ink mode

v1.10.0

Transcription
• New • Turn audio bookmarks into text, fully on your device (Settings > Advanced > Transcription)
• New • Pause and tap Find position in ebook, or highlight text while reading and find that spot in the audiobook
• New • With an EPUB on the book, a confident match uses the book's exact words

Reading
• New • Auto scroll: the next page rolls down over the current one, so the text never moves
• New • Share a highlight or bookmark note as a quote card over the book cover
• New • E•ink mode: flat, monochrome, no animations • great on a Boox Palma
• New • Tap a highlight to recolor, note, share, or jump to it in the audiobook, and see every book's highlights in All Bookmarks
• Improved • Reading uses less battery, big ebooks open faster

Scan Series
• New • A quick scan for upcoming books or a deep scan for missing ones, with release•day notifications on Android • scans remember finished series and skip them

Playback
• New • Progress from other devices catches up automatically, and the paused player follows along
• New • Sync to the server every 20 seconds instead of every minute
• New • Jump to a session's start or end from its details
• Fix • Headset play starts right away, and the widget and Android Auto no longer start or pause playback on their own

iOS
• New • Lock screen controls use your own skip amounts
• Improved • Bluetooth controls are much more reliable

Podcasts
• New • Subscribe without new episodes filling up Absorbing, plus Up Next and New filters and episode sorting

More
• New • Book subtitles in the library, more author and narrator sorts, Audible rating counts
• New • Settings sync across devices via your own WebDAV server
• New • Cover size setting, bulk book actions, delete from server, daily/weekly/monthly goals
• New • Queue auto•download keeps the next books in a series, show, or playlist downloaded
• New • Audiobookshelf 2.36 support and a bigger admin area
• Improved • Very large libraries load in pages, and search no longer floods the server
• Fix • Duplicate sessions inflating stats, search missing books past 10,000, collections missing on servers with very many
• Fix • Streamed books going silent or jumping back after a sync
• Fix • Smoother cover grids that no longer crash

v1.10.0•275
Beta 11

Ebook reader
• New • Auto scroll • the next page comes down over the current one from the top, so the text never moves. Tap to pause, press and hold to stop, drag to change speed. Start it from the up/down arrows button in the reader toolbar
• Improved • The reader's buttons moved to the bottom within thumb reach, with title, chapter and progress at the top
• Improved • Big ebooks open faster
• Fix • The first page of a chapter no longer counts as the last page of the one before

Library
• New • Book subtitles can show under titles in the library and on home, set globally or per library • the book details sheet always shows them
• New • The Audible score in book details shows how many ratings it is based on
• Fix • A series with a comma in its name, like "Love, Death + Robots", stays one series on the author page instead of splitting into two
• New • Sort authors by date added, and narrators by number of books

Playback
• Fix • Playback no longer pauses every few minutes on Android Auto when the phone's Bluetooth link to the head unit blips (369)
• Fix • Absorb no longer starts playing on its own when opened from the widget cover, from Recents, or right after an update
• Fix • A streamed book no longer cuts out a few seconds after you resume when the server had closed its session
• Fix • Deleting another episode of the podcast you are listening to no longer stops playback

Connection
• Fix • Absorb picks the local server address at launch again when it answers, instead of staying on the remote one until you switch by hand

iOS
• Fix • A multi•file book no longer jumps back to the start after a pause or seek when the server session was recreated behind playback

Equalizer
• Fix • A band reads 0 instead of "•/+0"

Podcasts
• Fix • The "Downloading N episodes" toast no longer shows on every launch for episodes you had deleted
• Fix • An episode you reset no longer drags auto•download to the newest episodes; the window follows the episode you are actually on

v1.10.0•267
Beta 10

Large libraries
• Improved • The library loads a small first page, then bigger pages fetched ahead of your scroll
• Fix • A page that fails to load shows a retry instead of a spinner forever
• Fix • Searching a library past 10,000 books no longer floods the server
• Fix • Opening a series from a book shows that book right away, with a retry if the server is slow
• Improved • The authors tab loads in pages instead of fetching every author at once

Sync
• Fix • A position that loses to the server is replaced instead of retrying forever, and reopening the app no longer re•saves a paused position as fresh (iPhone and iPad drifting minutes apart)

Downloads
• Fix • Deleting a book no longer lets auto•download bring it straight back; it stays gone until you download it yourself

Settings sync
• New • The Absorbing order syncs between devices
• Fix • Auto•download switches and reader looks stay on the device they were set on

Book sheet
• Fix • Descriptions keep their paragraph breaks and show in full

iOS
• Fix • Absorb leaves the headset with an app you paused instead of taking it back
• Fix • The lock screen shows the right chapter after a headset or widget session moved the book along while the app was asleep, and keeps the cover when playback starts
• Improved • Covers are dropped from memory in the background, so a paused Absorb is less likely to be evicted and lose Now Playing to another app

v1.10.0•265
Beta 9

Lists
• Fix • The Lists tab is always there now, instead of showing up only once collections had loaded. If they can't be loaded you get a message and a retry rather than the tab quietly disappearing (362)
• Fix • Collections and the Lists tab no longer disappear on servers with very many collections

Shortcuts
• Fix • Setting a tab's hold to "Ask next time" now asks. On the Absorbing tab it played or paused instead
• Fix • The tab hold settings say Now Playing when classic wording is on

E•ink devices
• Fix • The Absorbing icon no longer disappears into the black selected pill

Podcasts
• Fix • Episodes stay in place in the queue • pausing a fresh one doesn't send it to the end, and a new one doesn't shove your current listen out of the top spot

Android Auto & CarPlay
• New • Add a toggle to start playback automatically when Android Auto or CarPlay connects
• Fix • Ebook•only books no longer show up in the Android Auto and CarPlay browse tree

iPad
• Fix • The share sheet actually appears now
• Fix • The library keeps refilling instead of stalling on a spinner until you scroll

Player
• Improved • Bigger cover on the full screen player, percent folded into the timestamps row
• Improved • Sharper covers on the player cards

Settings
• New • Search jumps to and highlights the matching setting
• New • Lock screen skip icons are explained in the iOS skip settings

Ebook reader
• Fix • Text selection no longer leaves the ebook stuck between two pages
• Fix • Find in audiobook no longer lands in the wrong chapter
• Fix • Finding an ebook spot before audio has started uses your saved listening position
• New • Look up a selected word without leaving the app

Series
• Fix • Up Next shows the real next book in the series

Widgets
• Fix • Widgets stay wired up correctly after a reboot

iOS
• Improved • Bluetooth and lock screen controls are much more reliable

v1.9.3•248
Beta 8

Stats
• Fix • A crash when Android relaunched the app in the background no longer splits listening into dozens of duplicate sessions that inflate your listening stats (352)

Search
• Fix • Searching a library with more than 10,000 books now finds the newest books too, in the app and in Android Auto (349)

Transcription
• New • Transcription runs faster: a book's language is detected once and remembered instead of every single time, and a voice•detection pass that cost more than the transcribing itself is gone
• New • A new Base model (about 57 MB) sits between Tiny and Small, and the app picks the best downloaded model for each job on its own • the quickest one when the book's ebook supplies the exact words, the most accurate one you have when the transcript stands alone. Download one or all three and the picking takes care of itself
• Fix • Choosing Keep reading after finding your spot in the audiobook no longer opens the full screen player over the e•reader
• New • When a book has an ebook, transcribing a bookmark can swap Whisper's text for the ebook's exact words • a confident match means a word•perfect note (toggle in the transcribe popup)
• Fix • Transcribing bookmarks and finding your position now work for books downloaded to a custom Android folder, instead of asking you to download the book first
• Fix • Jumping between the ebook and audiobook could give up when a book spells out its chapter numbers ("Thirty•Nine" was mistaken for "Nine") or reuses chapter names between characters
• Fix • Transcribing a bookmark, finding your spot in the ebook and exporting a clip could start up to half a minute before the bookmark on MP3 files

Reading
• Fix • Very large illustrated ebooks crashed the app when opened
• New • Tap a highlight to change its color, add or edit its note, share it as a quote card, find that spot in the audiobook, or remove it
• Fix • A highlight could draw a few lines away from its own text when the book opened, most often on a device the highlight synced to
• Fix • The reader's settings sheet can now be swiped closed

Tips
• New • Tips & Hidden Features in Settings catches up on everything recent: transcription, jumping between formats, quote sharing, clip export, volume•key page turns and more

Bookmarks
• Fix • A bookmark note synced through the server now comes back apart as title and note on your other devices, instead of one long title
• Fix • Opening a book's bookmarks now pulls the latest from the server even when the book isn't playing
• Fix • Listen on a bookmark now plays on very long single•file audiobooks instead of erroring
• Fix • Podcast bookmarks now stay with the episode you made them on, and Listen, Transcribe and Export clip work on them. They travel between your devices in the settings backup, since the server has nowhere to keep an episode's bookmarks
• New • The bookmark button in Android Auto and CarPlay now works on podcast episodes

E•ink devices
• New • An e•ink mode under Settings > Appearance
    • light flat monochrome look, no animations or ripples, dark covers lifted so they keep detail on e•paper, and the live server connection rests to save battery
• New • Physical page•turn buttons (like the Boox Palma's side button) flip pages in the reader. Outside the reader screen, they play or pause the current book

Shortcuts
• New • Hold any tab in the bottom bar to pick what it does
    • Set it once per tab, or pick "Always show menu" to get the list every time (all of it under Settings > Advanced)

Podcasts
• Fix • Up Next now shows the episode you're partway through plus the next one waiting in that show, for every show you've started, instead of only episodes already started
• Fix • The Finished filter on the Episodes tab lists your finished episodes instead of always coming back empty

Book stats
• New • Listening stats at the bottom of a book's details: your time, sessions, and first and last listen. Admins also see everyone on the server • who started it, who finished it, and how long they spent

Backup & sync
• Fix • Restoring a backup that turns settings sync on now asks whether the server's copy or the backup wins, instead of quietly pushing the older backup to your other devices

Covers
• New • The full•screen cover view closes with a tap or a swipe, not just the X button

Beta 7

Transcription

• New • Turn audio bookmarks into text, fully on your device. Pick how much to transcribe 15s • 2min, then fix it up in the bookmark sheet
    • Enable it under settings > Advanced > Transcription and download a model. The Tiny Whisper model is about 31 MB and has been working great for me in testing. 

Find your spot between audiobook and ebook

• Both need the audiobook downloaded, transcription enabled, and an EPUB ebook file on the book.
• New • While listening, Pause your audiobook and tap Find position in ebook. The ebook will open after a small bit of audio gets transcribed and then searched across the ebook file for a match. 
• New • While reading, highlight some text and tap the headphones button at the bottom. The app will compare and find that spot in the audio book and start playing it. You can choose to stay in the e•reader or go to the player screen. 
• If a spot can’t be matched confidently by Absorb, nothing moves. 

Share quotes

• New • Share an ebook Highlight or an audiobook bookmark•note as a quote rendered over the book cover
    • A few settings to get your share image just right

Ebook Reader

• Find all of your highlights from every book in the All Bookmarks page in the settings. 
• Reading an ebook uses less battery

Settings sync

• Keep settings in sync across devices through your own WebDAV server. Settings > Backup and sync
    • Requires the folder you want to store the .json file in to already be created

iOS

• Lock screen controls now use your own skip amounts instead of always 10 and 30
    • Apple only has lock screen icons for 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 • any other amount shows as a "+" but still skips what you picked

v1.9.3•240
Beta 6

Playback
• Play from your headphones, the widget, the lock screen or AA/CP starts right away instead of waiting on the server, whether the book is downloaded or streamed
• Starting a downloaded book from headphones or the widget with the app closed is much faster, instead of 5 to 10 seconds, and works with no signal at all
• Pressing play in the app after a longer pause checks for progress made on another device before starting, and never jumps once audio is playing
• The session•start rewind is applied before playback begins, so no more burst of audio and then a jump on a fresh start
• Starting a downloaded book from a bookmark or chapter starts where you tapped instead of jumping ahead to the server position

Headphones
• Headsets that report a play press as "pause" now resume when paused

Widget
• The home screen widget shows paused when a call or another app interrupts playback, instead of counting on

Fix
• Scrolling a dense library grid, or any screen full of covers, no longer crashes • the app now builds on Flutter 3.47, which also makes scrolling smoother

v1.9.3•237
Beta 5

Scan Series
• Upcoming Releases is now Scan Series: a quick scan for upcoming books, or a deep scan that also finds missing books across every series
• Scans learn which series are finished and skip them, so repeat scans take a fraction of the time
• Get a notification the day a tracked book releases
• Long•press to select several books and request or remove them together
• Link a series by pasting its Audible ASIN when it can't be matched, and a scan report shows what was checked, skipped, or unmatched
• The skipped list opens its actions with a tap and supports multi•select
• Series scanning now works for Audible regions the metadata service doesn't cover, by falling back to the US catalog

Cross•device sync
• Progress made on other devices catches up when you come back to the app, even for events missed while it was in the background
• The paused player follows along too, so the card and resume point match where you left off elsewhere
• Books finished on another device leave Absorbing right away
• Progress reaches the server every 20 seconds instead of every minute

New
• Cover size setting: small, medium, or large covers across the library, with tablets scaling to match and labels growing with the covers
• Sort podcast episodes by publish date, title, season, episode number, or file name, in either direction
• Reset or extend the sleep timer with a headphone button press during the wind•down
• French language option, plus the latest community translations
• Remove a book's cover and leave it with none
• Pick several books on home or in the library and quick match, mark, or delete them at once
• Admin: scan schedules, metadata source ordering, a server logs screen, and podcast episode limits
• Admin: every Audible region can be picked as a library's metadata provider, plus custom providers from your server

Improved
• The generated title card shows on the home shelves and no longer gets cut off on small covers
• Bookmark, history, and chapter times show at your playback speed
• Progress numbers stay readable on tinted home cards

Fix
• A book's percentage on the server no longer drifts away from your actual listening position
• Now Playing no longer sticks on the last chapter when rereading a finished book
• Streams no longer cut out for a few seconds every hour
• A stuck player no longer banks hours you never listened or drags your place in a book backwards
• Chromecast reconnects after a background drop instead of dying for good
• The companion ebook downloads with the audiobook, so Read works offline

v1.9.3•233
Beta 3

• Queue auto•download for a series, show, playlist, or collection

Fix

• Playback no longer blips when a login session refreshes
• Covers load sooner in the full•screen player
• Books finished on another device leave Absorbing; replayed ones stay
• Queue auto•download actually downloads

Beta 3

• Fix • iOS fix double audio 285 
• Stop another app taking over when you resume iOS playback after a pause

v1.9.1 beta 1

• New • You can now pick a custom download folder ( android only • works on the Play Store version too (hopefully when approved)) through your phone's folder picker, with no special permissions. Downloads are sorted into author and title folders.
• Fix • Downloads are more reliable in the background and no longer get stuck in the download list.
• Fix • Fixed heavy battery use while paused. The app no longer keeps the CPU awake when you pause, so leaving it paused (even overnight) won't eat your battery.
• New • Customizable stats page, with listening goals, chart styles, challenge pace, weekday averages, and time saved by listening faster.
• New • Hide a book from your finished•this•year stats.
• New • Admins can export a setup file to sign a new user in.
• Fix • Seeking and resume position now work right when casting multi•file books.
• Fix • SSO login works on servers behind a proxy that needs custom headers.
• Fix • Falls back to your remote server instead of showing offline when the local address stops answering.
• Improved • Podcast episode titles show in the expanded Newest Episodes view, and badges update right after you finish an episode.
• Improved • Send•to•e•reader device list scrolls
• Improved • Server switch and session•expired messages use absorb style toast message
• Improved • The login screen now shows why a server connection failed instead of just "could not reach server"

v1.9.0

Editing tools for your books, more controls in the car, and a native engine on iOS.

Books
• New • A new Edit page brings all the book tools together: metadata, cover, chapters, match, Encode, and Embed.
• New • Chapter editor to rename chapters and set their times, with play•preview to set starts by ear.
• New • Embed Metadata tool (admin) writes tags, chapters, and cover art into your audio files.
• New • Pick which fields to apply when matching a book to server metadata.
• New • Remove a book from Continue Listening, or a series from Continue Series.
• New • Long•press a cover for a quick menu with Play, Download, and more, without opening the full page.

Android Auto & CarPlay
• New • Chapter skip, playback speed, and one•tap bookmark controls. The speed button shows your current rate and cycles your presets.
• New • Browse big libraries by letter, and tap a book to jump straight to Now Playing.

Playback
• New • Sleep timer option to stop at the end of the current podcast episode.
• New • Lock the seek bar so you can't scrub by accident from the notification, lockscreen, or car.
• Fix • Podcast queue Up Next now works, and a podcast no longer switches to an audiobook when an episode ends.

Player
• New • Card background: show the cover art blurred or as a gradient behind the player, or turn it off.

iOS
• New • Native audio engine, with a properly advancing background queue.

Bookmarks
• New • Roomier editor with a bigger note field, fine time nudging, and a Listen button to hear the spot without jumping to that position.

Admin
• New • API Keys to create, view, and revoke keys

Translations
• New • Absorb is now open for community translation on [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/absorb)

Also in this release
• Local overrides now show everywhere, a Progress text•size setting, blue/green connection icons, in•place server•address editing, a tidier admin Users page, plus smaller fixes and polish throughout.

CarPlay & Android Auto
• New • Browse big libraries by letter, so nothing gets cut off, and big libraries no longer crash
• New • Tapping a book jumps straight to Now Playing

Bookmarks
• New • Roomier editor with a bigger note field, fine time nudging (synced to the server), and a Listen button to hear the spot without losing your place
• Fix • The bookmarks page and in•player sheet no longer hang

Metadata & covers
• New • Choose which fields to apply when matching a book to server metadata
• New • Local metadata and cover overrides now show everywhere, not just the book page
• Fix • A cover's yellow "Only from Audible" badge no longer throws off the accent color

Upcoming releases
• New • Add or remove books on the Upcoming Releases page

Player
• New • Lock the seek bar so you can't scrub by accident from the notification, lockscreen or car

Admin
• New • Unlink a user's OpenID (229)
• New • Edit a saved server's address in place, without re•adding it (257)

v1.8.96

More playback controls when you're behind the wheel • chapter skips, a live speed button, and quick one•tap bookmarks.

•••

Android Auto & Apple CarPlay
• New • Chapter skip, playback speed, and bookmark controls, on top of the usual play and skip.
• New • The speed button shows your current rate (like 1.5x) and cycles through your speed presets.
• New • Bookmark straight from the car, with a quick on•screen confirmation.

Playback
• New • (Android) A setting to pick whether the phone's media controls show chapter skip, or speed and bookmark.

v1.8.95

The book "..." menu now has a dedicated Edit page that brings all the book tools together • metadata, cover, chapters, match, Encode, and Embed • in one place.

• New • Chapter editor: edit chapter titles and times, with a play•preview to set starts by ear.
• New • Embed Metadata tool (admin) to write tags, chapters, and cover art into your audio files, with live progress.
• New • Remove a book from Continue Listening, or a whole series from Continue Series, from the book "..." menu.

> This is for books for now. Podcast editing is coming in a later release.

•••

Admin
• New • API Keys: create, view, and revoke keys for apps and scripts that connect to your server, right from the admin page.
• Improved • the Users page is now a grid of name pills, with online users outlined in green and a last•seen time on each.

Playback
• New • sleep timer option to stop at the end of the current podcast episode, without affecting the rest of your queue.
• Fix • opening Absorb no longer pauses audio playing in other apps before you've pressed play.
• Fix • playback now pauses when you disconnect the device you're listening through, even if another Bluetooth device stays connected.
• Fix • sleep timer rewinds now show as an auto•rewind in the playback history instead of looking like a manual seek.

Appearance
• New • a Progress text size setting (Settings > Appearance) to enlarge the time and percent text on the player, including the chapter times.

Translations
• New • more German translations, thanks to the community on [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/absorb).

Playback
• Fix • podcast queue Up Next now works and updates as you change the queue
• Fix • a podcast no longer switches to an audiobook when an episode ends
• Fix • Android Auto no longer phantom•resumes Absorb after you disconnect
• New • default speed can now be set in 0.05 steps

Sleep timer
• New • Auto resume default slider now in the sleep timer settings

Connection
• New • Local server setup now has a Set button so it's clear when your address is saved
• New • connection icon is blue for a local server and green for remote

iOS
• Fix • background queue now advances correctly
• New • native audio engine

Translations
• New • Absorb is now open for community translation on [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/absorb) • help translate the app into your language
• Thanks to [Engi](https://crowdin.com/profile/engifrance) (French) and [Frumkin](https://crowdin.com/profile/frumkin) (Russian) for the first community translations

v1.8.90

Landscape mode
• New • The whole app works in landscape, with a two•pane layout for the absorbing screen, full player, and car mode.

Library
• New • Narrators tab next to Authors.
• New • Filter library by tag, with tappable tag chips on book detail.
• New • Search library tags and genres.
• New • Filter the Series tab by progress.

Queue & playlist
• New • Playlist queue mode plays through a playlist in order, with an "Up next" indicator on the Absorbing page.

Ebooks
• New • Send to E•Reader from the book detail menu for any book with an ebook file. Picks the device automatically when you have one configured, shows a picker when there's more than one.

ReadMeABook
• New • Connect your RMAB instance under Settings or Admin to request books from inside the app, with a "My Requests" tab to track status.

Audio
• New • Skip Silence toggle in the EQ sheet (Android only).
• New • Pick a specific chapter to sleep at on the sleep timer.
• New • Edit the quick•pick speed chips in the speed sheet.

Admin
• New • SMTP and ereader device management page on server settings page
• New • Admins (not just root) can now reach Settings •> Admin Controls, the manage button on podcast libraries, add to collection, edit author, and edit / reorder collections. Destructive actions still need the delete permission from root, but they now show a clear message if you don't have it.
• New • Multiple series per book and editable tags in the metadata editor.
• New • Edit an author or quick•match against Audible from the author sheet.
• New • Start an M4B encode from the edit server details sheet.

Language & appearance
• New • Choose the app language manually in Settings.
• New • Classic wording toggle: swap "Absorb / Absorbing / Fully Absorbed" for "Play / Now Playing / Finished".

fixes & improvements 
• Fix • In•app updater actually downloads and installs the APK directly now, no more browser hang
• Fix • Notification, lock screen, and Bluetooth controls stay alive after a long pause.
• Fix • Offline listening progress no longer regresses after returning to your home network.
• Fix • No more ghost 10•hour•long listening sessions on the server.
• Offline bookmarks no longer wipe on app restart before they sync.
• iOS: last chapter of multi•file audiobooks no longer skips, and Bluetooth skip controls now work.
• Offline downloaded podcasts open with correct duration and seek bar.
• Android Auto / CarPlay: series sort by sequence number, cover updates show after browse, AA back nav keeps scroll position.
• "Hey Google, rewind a minute" no longer snaps back.
• Switching libraries no longer stops playback when Unified Absorbing page is enabled.

v1.8.89

Queue & playlist (new)
• New • Playlist queue mode. Tap "Play playlist" on any playlist to start playing through its items in order. Each item auto•plays the next when finished.
• New • "Up next" indicator on the Absorbing page tells you what plays next under the queue chip. Toggle in the manage queue sheet to hide it.
• New • The manage queue sheet now matches the active mode. It shows your series in sequence (auto•next mode) or the playlist's items (playlist mode) instead of always showing the manual queue.

Android Auto & CarPlay
• Fix • Series view sorts books by sequence number, so book 2 comes before book 10.
• Fix • Cover changes on the server now show up after the next browse, and re•downloading a book pulls a fresh cover too.

Android Auto
• Fix • Back navigation keeps your scroll position instead of jumping to the top.

Playback & sync
• Fix • "Hey Google, rewind a minute" no longer jumps back to where you were a moment later.
• Fix • No more ghost 10•hour•long listening sessions appearing on the server.
• Fix • Stop silently dropping unsynced local progress when the server and local both have unsynced changes.
• Fix • The sync no longer loops retrying when local and server are at the same position.
• Fix • Sleep timer countdown ticks every second instead of every five.
• Fix • Skip controls from Bluetooth devices now work on iOS.

Other
• Fix • Non•admin users with the "Update" permission can now edit metadata in the app (fixes 225).
• Update • "Merge libraries" setting renamed to "Unified Absorbing page" to make it clear it only affects what shows on the Absorbing page. Follows the "classic wording" toggle too.

v1.8.87

New
• Feature • ReadMeABook integration. Set it up under Settings or Admin with your RMAB URL and an API token, then request books directly from the app. A "My Requests" tab inside the RMAB tile tracks the status of everything you've sent.
• Feature • "Request via ReadMeABook" appears under the empty library search state, at the bottom of library search results, in the Upcoming Releases per•book menu, and on missing books in an Audible series.

Fixes
• Fix • Tapping a tag or genre chip from a book detail sheet opened inside the full player now closes the player and lands on the filtered library.
• Fix • Tapping a tag or genre chip right after opening the app no longer shows the default library; the filter applies on the first try.
